title: Mixed review
text:
Mixed review. There are some things to like about this juicer, and some things to hate. On the like side, It is easy to operate and gets a good amount of juice for the effort. On the hate side, there is an area under the juicing mechanism that the juice gets into and you can't clean it. Also, the juice chute gets clogged VERY easily. It has a little rubber-like arm that swings up and covers the exit for the juice...like a little hatch cover, sort of. Even though it can swing up and down, uncovering and covering the exit chute when the unit is not connected to the motor base, it can only be in the closed position where it is connected to the base. This little piece is not explained in the manual. I don't know what it is for, all it seems to do to me is make it impossible for the juice to come out correctly.

I made a recipe that was included in the manual; carrot, pear, celery and ginger. The recipes and instructions for what kinds of fruits and veggies are confusing. For instance, it tells you in the warnings not to use celery, but then gives a recipe using celery. What??? So, I just followed the recipes.

This was my first experience ever trying to do juicing, so I don't know what the results are supposed to be like. It makes good juice, but the clogging situation makes it unusable.

product_metadata.title: DASH Deluxe Compact Masticating Slow Juicer, Easy to Clean Cold Press Juicer with Brush, Pulp Measuring Cup, Frozen Attachment and Juice Recipe Guide - Graphite
features: MAKE HEALTHY AND DELICIOUS JUICES: Powerful 130 Watt motor extracts the maximum amount of nutrients, vitamins, taste and juice from minimum amounts of fruits, vegetables, leafy greens, nuts and wheatgrass.

MAKE DELICIOUS SORBET: The frozen attachment included with this juicer allows you to make homemade sorbet and other frozen treats.
INCLUDES: Amazon Exclusive. Dash Deluxe Compact Power Slow Juicer, Frozen Attachment, Pulp Measuring Cup, Cleaning Brush and Recipe Guide. Cord Length: 35 inches, Voltage: 120V.
U.S. Use Only 120V. Powerful enough to make almond and cashew milk!
description: Make delicious cold-pressed juice with the Dash Deluxe Compact Power Slow Juicer. Just add fresh fruit and let this juicer do the work, fully separating pulp from juice and ensuring you get the most nutrients in your drinks. Juice made with the Slow Juicer oxidizes more slowly, meaning your juice stays fresh for longer! The Juicer comes with everything you need, including an Ingredient Pusher, Cleaning Brush, and Measuring Cup for pulp. Plus, make delicious frozen treats with the included Frozen Attachment. The compact size is perfect for smaller kitchens, and is a great space-saver for anyone looking to make cold-pressed juice at home without sacrificing power and durability!
